key_idea: Map characters to 28 positions on a circle; each move costs min(d,28-d) arcs of length 60*pi/28 feet at 15 ft/s, plus one second per pickup.
sketch: Read each line with getline (aphorisms contain spaces and apostrophes), map A-Z to 0..25, space to 26 and the quote to 27. Sum min(|a-b|, 28-|a-b|) over consecutive characters, multiply by (60*pi/28)/15 and add the string length for pickups. O(length). Pitfalls: diameter is 60 so circumference is 60*pi, consume the newline after N, and strip trailing carriage returns.
